usage: Use 運動 as a general noun for sports, exercise, or physical activity. It is very common in everyday Cantonese.
It can refer to a specific sport or to doing exercise in general, depending on context. For example, it often covers both team sports and fitness activities.
Common patterns include talking about liking, doing, playing, or taking part in 運動. It sounds natural in school, work, and health-related conversation.
For learners, 運動 is a broad, neutral word. If you mean a specific sport, you can add the sport name before or after it.
